_doc: Blanket per-commit exclusions. Each entry says 'this commit is bad —
exclude any run whose cfg.git_commit starts with `commit_prefix`.'
1. We know a commit produced incorrect output, AND
2. We CANNOT pin the bug to a cfg-predicate (e.g. an invariant of the
form 'cfgs matching X require fix-commit Y as ancestor').
Prefer `invariants.py` predicates when possible — they generalize to
future commits with the same property. Reach for commit_exclusions only
when a bug was specific to a commit in a way you cannot characterize.
Schema: list of {commit_prefix, reason}. The loader matches by prefix

entries.reason: chord-tight algorithmic regression; fixed in later commit
polar-k3 regression at r256 rerun / rsweep

r64_chord_postfix_validation runs systematically +0.01 above seed cluster from later commits; subtle regression in precond_delta_relative kwarg threading. Specific affected sweep also enumerated in run_exclusions.json.

precond_delta_relative=True interpreted as absolute δ; fixed in ef6b3bc. (Non-ε_rel runs at this commit may be unaffected by the specific bug but the legacy registry blanket-excluded; preserved for behavioral equivalence.)
